free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the evidence strongly supports sampling due to the high PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right mid-peripheral zone and the concerning PSA velocity of 0.66 ng/mL/yr. This finding is further supported by the rising PSA trend from 2.5 ng/mL to 4.2 ng/mL and the fact that the prior biopsy was positive, necessitating re-evaluation of the current status.
